in_marathi.name: Geethavarthini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Song of the chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geethavarthini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geetha (song) + Varthini (chariot). This name refers to the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and learning. It is believed that the name Geethavarthini bestows the blessings of knowledge and learning upon the child.

in_bengali.name: Geethavarthini

This name refers to the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and learning. It is believed that the name Geethavarthini bestows the blessings of knowledge and learning upon the child.
